evidence.name: Screen field: Where the label sits
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Where the label sits" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Where the label sits
sections.description: Horizontal position of the selection label within its container: left, center, or right (default center). Center usually lines up with the centered wheels and is the safe choice; switch to left or right only to align the label with other text or a specific layout. This is purely visual and does not change the value the user selected.
